{{Top|leg}}
'''B-0F9''' was a [[Navigation buoy/Legends|navigation buoy]] in the [[Parmel system/Legends|Parmel system]]. Following the [[Evacuation of Research|evacuation]] of [[XQ6 Platform]] ''[[Research]]'', [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces traveled to B-0F9 to transfer prototypes of the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] from the [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] ''[[Mharsup]]'' to the [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|''Assassin''-class corvette]] group [[Hashim group|''Hashim'']] for delivery to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]].
